article.story: STANFORD, Calif. -- — Austin Maurer scored 13 points and Julius Price scored 12 points and Stanford avoided UC Irvine's upset bid by beating the Anteaters 65-61 on Tuesday night. Reserves Christian Bliss scored 11 points and Aziz Olajuwon scored 10 for Stanford (4-1). Jovan Jester Jr. scored 14 points, Tama Isaac and reserve Josiah Johnson each scored 11 and Nils Cooper 10 for UC Irvine (3-1). Stanford needed an 8-0 run in the final 2:33 to get the win. Olajuwon and Bliss made consecutive 3-pointers in a 45-second span to put the Cardinal ahead 61-60, Stanford's first lead since 16:20 remained in the first half. Johnson's basket with 12:13 remaining gave UC Irvine its last double-digit lead at 49-39 before the Cardinal began a methodical climb back. The Anteaters used a 17-2 run and turned a 5-3 deficit three minutes in to a 20-7 lead midway through the first half. Luke Issak made consecutive 3-pointers and Mason Hodges converted a three-point play during Irvine's offensive outburst. Irvine led 39-28 at halftime. Stanford owns a 6-1 all-time advantage against UC Irvine. Before Tuesday, the two last met almost 21 years ago. Up next UC Irvine: Hosts San Diego on Saturday. Stanford: Hosts Sacramento State on Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here. Visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college football coverage here.
